properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.enabled
properties.description: Enable the scheduler engine and worker maintenance services. Set to false for submission-only nodes that delegate job execution elsewhere.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Polling interval for the scheduler in milliseconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.busy-polling-interval-ms
properties.description: Sleep in milliseconds between claim attempts while at least one permit is held. Shorter than the idle polling interval.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.max-claim-batch
properties.description: Maximum number of ready jobs claimed from one priority queue per scheduler poll.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.queue-prefix
properties.description: Redis key prefix for queue sorted sets.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.high
properties.description: Weight for high-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.normal
properties.description: Weight for normal-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.scheduler.weights.low
properties.description: Weight for low-priority queue in deficit round-robin.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Maximum retry attempts before job moves to DLQ.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.initial-delay-seconds
properties.description: Initial delay before first retry in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.backoff-multiplier
properties.description: Exponential backoff multiplier for retry delays.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retry.jitter-factor
properties.description: Random spread applied to each retry delay, as a fraction of the base delay (0.0 disables, 1.0 allows +/-100%).

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.maintenance-pool-size
properties.description: Threads reserved for retry promotion, lease recovery, and orphan reconciliation so one blocked task cannot stall the others.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.lease-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Lease timeout for running jobs in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.retry-promoter-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval for promoting retry-scheduled jobs back to queue.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.retry-promoter-scan-limit
properties.description: Maximum due retry records promoted per retry-promoter pass.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.lease-reaper-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval for recovering expired leases.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.lease-reaper-scan-limit
properties.description: Maximum expired lease records inspected per reaper pass.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.orphan-reconcile-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval for re-queueing QUEUED records that have no priority-queue entry after a crash.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.orphan-reconcile-scan-limit
properties.description: Maximum orphaned QUEUED records inspected per reconciliation pass.

properties.name: simplydone4j.worker.orphan-grace-ms
properties.description: Age a QUEUED record must reach before orphan reconciliation may re-queue it, protecting in-flight submissions.

properties.name: simplydone4j.submission.reservation-record-wait-ms
properties.description: Maximum time a duplicate submission waits for the reservation owner's job record to become visible.

properties.name: simplydone4j.submission.admission-wait-ms
properties.description: Maximum time duplicate resolution waits for a QUEUED job's queue admission to become visible before returning a retryable conflict.

properties.name: simplydone4j.submission.resolve-poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Polling interval used while resolving an in-flight duplicate submission.

properties.name: simplydone4j.submission.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum serialized payload size in UTF-8 bytes. A value of 0 disables the limit.

properties.name: simplydone4j.queue.max-depth
properties.description: Admission cap for submissions and scheduled retries across all priority queues. Claim restoration may briefly exceed it by the in-flight worker count.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.core-pool-size
properties.description: Core thread pool size for job execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.max-pool-size
properties.description: Maximum thread pool size for job execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.queue-capacity
properties.description: Retained for compatibility. Dispatch hands work directly to a worker thread so a queued task cannot let its lease expire before execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.keep-alive-seconds
properties.description: Keep-alive time for idle threads in seconds.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.default-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Default timeout for job handler execution.

properties.name: simplydone4j.executor.await-termination-seconds
properties.description: Seconds to wait for thread pool to terminate on shutdown.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retention.clear-payload-on-completion
properties.description: Clear the stored job payload when a job reaches a terminal state.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retention.store-execution-logs
properties.description: Persist execution logs for job runs.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retention.max-execution-logs-per-job
properties.description: Maximum execution log entries retained per job.

properties.name: simplydone4j.retention.execution-log-ttl-days
properties.description: Retention period for execution log entries in days.

properties.name: simplydone4j.key-prefix
properties.description: Global Redis key prefix for all SimplyDone4J data.

properties.name: simplydone4j.ttl-days
properties.description: TTL in days for finished (success/failed/DLQ/cancelled) job data. Combined with ttl-hours.

properties.name: simplydone4j.ttl-hours
properties.description: TTL in hours for finished job data. The effective retention is max(1, ttl-days * 24 + ttl-hours) hours.

properties.name: simplydone4j.idempotency-ttl-hours
properties.description: TTL in hours for idempotency lock entries.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.sentinel-master
properties.description: Redis Sentinel master name. Requires simplydone4j.redis.sentinel-nodes.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.sentinel-nodes
properties.description: Sentinel or Cluster nodes as host:port entries.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.cluster-mode
properties.description: Treat sentinel-nodes as a Redis Cluster rather than Sentinel nodes.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.password
properties.description: Password for authenticated Sentinel or Cluster connections.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.pool-max-total
properties.description: Maximum pooled Lettuce connections for Sentinel/Cluster factories, including dedicated WATCH/MULTI connections.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.pool-max-idle
properties.description: Maximum idle pooled Lettuce connections for Sentinel/Cluster factories.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.pool-min-idle
properties.description: Minimum idle pooled Lettuce connections maintained for Sentinel/Cluster factories.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.pool-max-wait-ms
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for a pooled connection before failing.

properties.name: simplydone4j.redis.command-timeout-ms
properties.description: Timeout for Sentinel/Cluster Redis commands, bounding health checks and submissions when Redis is unreachable.
